text:
maria: Pelago reported a sudden tail-latency spike after last night's runtime deploy. p99 went from ~180ms to ~1.9s around 02:12 UTC. No error-rate increase. Can we triage?

support-bot: INC-2026-4587 created by support@pelago — summary: customer-facing latency spike, affected model: redwood/open-compat-v2-q4, region: us-west-2. Link: https://inc.local/INC-2026-4587

darren: on it. pulling kv-cache hit rates + kernel-selector logs now. which workload sample should I use?

maria: customer sent a few example requests in the ticket — mostly short prompts (~40 tokens) but many concurrent sessions with long context reuse. no big change in qps reported.

rahul: pasting a curl sample they gave:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -d '{"model":"open-compat-v2-q4","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":64}'
```

sophie: this smells like the kernel-selector fallback we rolled yesterday. saw higher syscall latencies on quantized execution path in staging. can we force `kernel=legacy` on a single node to compare?

maria: good idea. darren — can you run a quick canary: one node with kernel=legacy, one with kernel=auto, same traffic? run `bench/latency --profile --target pelago --duration 5m` and capture p50/p95/p99 + cpu/gpu util.

darren: running now. ETA ~6m.

darren: results (short run): p50 150ms, p95 320ms, p99 1.85s on kernel=auto; kernel=legacy: p50 160ms, p95 340ms, p99 230ms. GPU util similar, but syscall wait spikes only on auto. raw snippet:
```
[auto] p99=1850ms sys_wait=18.4ms
[legacy] p99=230ms sys_wait=2.1ms
```

sophie: that's a clear delta. kernel-selector is picking a quantized-path kernel that introduces a blocking syscall under our batching pattern. likely serialization inside kv cache handling.

maria: ok — plan: 1) roll kernel-selector rollback on pelago fleet to legacy for that model (hotfix), 2) open follow-up to fix selector heuristics (deferred), 3) tell customer we're reverting and monitoring. who owns the hotfix?

darren: I'll push the canary rollback and then roll to remaining nodes if stable. starting now.

rahul: I'll update the support ticket and ping Pelago PM with the rollback ETA (~10m after canary).

sophie: I'll add a unit test and a regression eval for the quantized-path kernel under small-batch, frequent-context scenarios.

maria: sweet. add a short blameless note for postmortem if rollback confirmed. status update in 15. :thumbsup:

darren: canary looks good so far, p99 down to ~220ms. rolling remainder.

support-bot: INC-2026-4587 status updated: mitigation in progress (kernel-selector rollback).

maria: closing loop — Pelago PM confirmed improved experience after rollback. follow-ups: ticket INC-2026-4590 for selector-improvement, and ENG-RUNTIME-382 for regression test. thanks team. :heart:
